treasure-island.name: San Francisco
treasure-island.blurb: The peninsula city at the Golden Gate - the Bay Area’s historic urban core, west across the bay from the campus island.

treasure-island.name: Sausalito
treasure-island.blurb: Waterfront town just inside the Golden Gate, on Richardson Bay under the Marin Headlands.

treasure-island.name: Alameda
treasure-island.blurb: Island city in San Francisco Bay beside Oakland, on the grounds of the former naval air station.

treasure-island.name: Daly City
treasure-island.blurb: The gateway city where the San Francisco peninsula meets San Mateo County.

treasure-island.name: Richmond
treasure-island.blurb: East Bay port city on San Pablo Bay, home of the wartime Kaiser shipyards.

treasure-island.name: San Rafael
treasure-island.blurb: Marin County’s seat, north of the bay along the 101 corridor.

treasure-island.name: South San Francisco
treasure-island.blurb: The industrial city - its hillside sign says so - between San Francisco and the airport.

treasure-island.name: San Mateo
treasure-island.blurb: Peninsula city midway between San Francisco and Silicon Valley.

oakland.name: Berkeley
oakland.blurb: East Bay city, home of the University of California’s founding campus.

oakland.name: Emeryville
oakland.blurb: Compact industrial-turned-tech city at the foot of the Bay Bridge approach.

oakland.name: Alameda
oakland.blurb: Island city in San Francisco Bay beside Oakland, on the grounds of the former naval air station.

oakland.name: San Leandro
oakland.blurb: East Bay manufacturing city directly south of Oakland.

new-orleans.name: Tulane University
new-orleans.blurb: Private research university Uptown on St. Charles Avenue, founded 1834; engineering and architecture among its schools.

new-orleans.name: Xavier University
new-orleans.blurb: Xavier University of Louisiana - the nation’s only historically Black and Catholic university.

new-orleans.name: University of New Orleans
new-orleans.blurb: Public research university on the Lake Pontchartrain shore; home to naval architecture and marine engineering.

new-orleans.name: Delgado Community College
new-orleans.blurb: Louisiana’s largest community college, City Park campus - the region’s major technical and trades educator.

new-orleans.name: Loyola University
new-orleans.blurb: Jesuit university on St. Charles Avenue, directly beside Tulane at Audubon Park.

new-orleans.name: Dillard University
new-orleans.blurb: Historically Black university on Gentilly Boulevard, known for its oak-lined Avenue of the Oaks.

new-orleans.name: SUNO
new-orleans.blurb: Southern University at New Orleans - public historically Black university in Pontchartrain Park.

walk.pace_note: a ten-minute walk at a normal pace is about 800 m; fifteen minutes about 1.2 km

honesty.not_a_score: this is not Walk Score(R) and no relationship with it is claimed or implied.
honesty.straight_line: distance here is straight-line between coordinates, not a street-network walk: a freeway, a rail cut, a canal or a gated block makes the real walk longer, sometimes impossibly longer. Walk the block before you believe the number.
honesty.what_it_counts: the Academy draws the bands around a campus and reports which RECORDED anchors fall inside them. It counts no shops, because this bundle holds no shop records - the classes above are carried so the map can say what a walkable measure would have to count.
